hints.title: Bitmask State of Satisfied Multiples
hints.text: Notice that target has length at most 4, enabling a bitmask of up to 16 states.

hints.title: Subset Least Common Multiples
hints.text: Precompute the least common multiple for every non-empty subset of target elements.

hints.title: Knapsack Bitwise Transitions
hints.text: For each array element, evaluate increments required to achieve the multiple for every subset and transition DP states.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Transitions through 16 bitmask states per element with precomputed subset least common multiples.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Independently matching elements ignores shared common multiples that satisfy multiple targets simultaneously.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask DP array has fixed size 16.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines number theory least common multiples with bitmask dynamic programming.
